series_start_reason: Series starts at the first quarter with a non-nil figure (2018Q4 = 3). Teva's release states the launch was in September 2018 (2018Q3); the 2018Q1-2018Q3 North America AJOVY figures are printed as dashes in the 2019 10-Q prior-year columns, and the 2018Q4 figure appears only as a prior-year column of the Q4 2019 release.
series_end_reason: From the first-quarter 2024 10-Q Teva headed the table 'United States' instead of 'North America' (which included Canada) and restated 2023; the AJOVY 2023 quarters on the new basis differ from those first printed (e.g. 2023Q1 46 vs 49), so the series is ended rather than spliced. The continuation on the United States basis, 2023Q1-2026Q2 (2023 restated), is staged separately as teva_ajovy_us_segment.
moa: Calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) antagonist monoclonal antibody

approval_evidence.quote: AJOVYTM (fremanezumab-vfrm) injection, for subcutaneous use ... Initial U.S. Approval: 2018

search_log: Listed every Teva filing via data.sec.gov submissions (all forms): 6-K, 6-K/A, 8-K, 8-K/A, 10-Q, 10-K, 20-F from 2016-04 through 2026-09 (293 filings; 6-K to 2017, 8-K and 10-Q/10-K from 2018).

Fetched every htm document of those filings and counted hits for the brand and generic names (cache/teva_scan.json); then extracted every table row whose first cell names the product (scripts/teva_rows.py).

Revenue rows for AUSTEDO and AJOVY first appear in the first-quarter 2018 10-Q / release (AUSTEDO) and the first-quarter 2019 10-Q (AJOVY); Teva's 2017 6-K quarterly reports carry no product revenue row for either.

Read the segment table of each 10-Q (Q1-Q3) and of the earnings release filed after year-end (Q4); cross-checked year-to-date columns, next-year prior-year columns and the release full-year row (scripts/teva_build.py).

Scope: AJOVY is printed per segment (North America, Europe, Growth Markets/International Markets); Teva prints no worldwide AJOVY total in its tables (global figures appear only in some release highlight text, e.g. 2024Q2 115, 2024Q3 137). The North America / United States row is the largest segment row in the 10-Q quarters 2019Q1-2023Q3 and in 2024Q3, 2025Q3, 2026Q1 and 2026Q2, but the Europe row is larger in 2024Q1 (51 vs 45), 2024Q2 (52 vs 42), 2025Q1 (58 vs 53) and 2025Q2 (71 vs 63) (scripts/teva_ajovy_scope.py, three-month columns of the first table per segment; Q1-Q3 only, the Q4 releases were not compared). The recorded line is the North America / United States segment row throughout (one consistent scope, not always the largest); segments are not summed.
Launch: Q4 2018 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/818686/000115752319000320/a51939836ex99_1.htm) says 'AJOVY is performing very well since its September launch in the U.S.'.
